binaryVersionSelector.label: Selects which hashcat binary version pattern a job should use: an exact pin, or auto-updating within a major/minor version.

task.reconnect_pending: The controlling connection to the agent running this task was lost; it is waiting to reconnect (not failed).
task.processing_error: A non-fatal error occurred while processing this task's output; the task is not necessarily failed.

hashlist.awaiting_validation_decision: The hashlist upload contains lines that didn't parse as valid hashes; an admin must decide how to proceed.

verification.verified: Checksum/integrity verification status for an uploaded wordlist, rule, or hashcat binary file — not user identity verification.

cloud.draining: This cloud agent instance is finishing its current task and will not be given new work before it's terminated.
cloud.syncing: This cloud agent instance is downloading wordlists/rules before it can start cracking.

loopback.active: 'Loopback' re-runs an attack's rules against newly-cracked passwords until no more cracks are found; 'Active' means a loopback round is currently running.

sync.in_progress: Status of a background file-sync operation (e.g. syncing wordlists/rules to or from a network share).

charsetInputs.referencedNotDefined: This custom charset slot (?1-?4) is used in the mask pattern but has no characters defined for it yet.
charsetInputs.willEnableHex: Appended warning: saving will switch this charset's other slots to hex-encoded mode too, since mixing modes isn't allowed.
charsetInputs.willDisableHex: Appended warning: saving will switch this charset's other slots out of hex-encoded mode, since mixing modes isn't allowed.

teamFilter.adminBadge: Shown when the current user has the admin role within that specific team (not necessarily a system-wide admin).

versionInfo.release: The overall KrakenHashes release version (from versions.json), distinct from the individual component versions below it.

footer.release: {{version}} is the overall product release version, not any single component's version.

confirmations.typeToConfirm: {{text}} is the exact phrase (e.g. a resource's name) the user must retype to confirm a destructive action.
